title: 第九章 土崩瓦狗第十章 炼器
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
徐家有五座兵器坊，分布在沧澜城各处，每天出产大量的兵器。
这几日发生了很多事情，徐家炼器大师被田家挖走，新人炼制手法不成熟，导致徐家的兵器总是出问题，重新培养，需要很长一段时间。
昨天大殿拿回来的那些兵器，都是残次品。
朝最近一座兵器坊赶去，路程需要一炷香左右时间。
耳朵突然一动，嘴角露出一丝冷笑：“还真有不知死活的跟在我身后，我倒想要看看，是谁一直跟着我。”
绕开大路，拐过一条街道，进入一座无人小巷，两侧都是高大的院墙，深处还有腥臭的味道传来，许多过往之人，在此地方便。
停住身体，在他身后传来嗖嗖声，六道人影，围住小巷的出口。
“你们跟我这么久，一直藏头露尾下去吗。”
朝六人看去，黑衣蒙面，只保留一双眼睛在外面，手持明晃的兵器，眸中释放出惊天杀气，弥漫整个小巷。
一男子正要进来小便，撞到这一幕，吓得魂飞魄散，裤子都没提上就跑了。
“废物，今天就是你的死期，还不乖乖的跪下求饶。”
低沉的声音，从中间男子口中发出，一步步逼近，形成一个小包围圈，以免被柳无邪逃走。
六人实力都不低，只有一人是后天五重，其他五人清一色后天六重境，
“周桐，在丹宝阁我没杀你，没想到你还不死心，你这是在自掘坟墓。”
柳无邪眼眸突然定格在右侧一名男子脸上，吓得他身体往后退了一步，他的身份怎么会被识破。
“你这个废物，在丹宝阁扇我耳光，害得我失去丹宝阁这个职位，今天就是你的死期。”
周桐摘下面罩，面目狰狞，昨日离开丹宝阁之后，拿出所有积蓄，雇来五名杀手，一直守在徐家大门外，终于抓到了机会。
失去丹宝阁这座大靠山，周桐以后将寸步难行，这几年沾染了赌习，欠了一屁股债，他身为丹宝阁小头目，那些债主不敢拿他怎么样。
没有丹宝阁撑腰，用不了多久，那些债主纷纷上门，他所拥有的一切，将会彻底失去，包括他养的几名小妾。
“就凭你们这些垃圾也想杀我。”

嘴角露出一抹邪笑，就算是半步先天想要杀他都不可能，何况是小小的后天境。
“别跟他废话，赶紧杀了他！”
五名杀手没少做杀人的勾当，多一句废话都没有，坏人死于话多，这个道理他们非常清楚。
长刀凌空劈下，刀气直逼柳无邪的面门，让空气变得无比躁动，无数气旋在空中炸开，简单的合击阵法，分别对应五行方位。
周桐没有出手，退到一旁，双眼露出一丝疯狂。
“一群土崩瓦狗！”
柳无邪突然消失在原地，七星步施展，犹如一道道残影，消失在原地，五人的攻击，全部落空。
谁会料到，柳无邪施展如此精妙的步伐，如同鬼影，扑捉不到任何痕迹，突然出现在圈子外面，手掌如刀，狠狠的切下。
“咔嚓！”
身前黑衣人仰面倒下，被柳无邪一掌切断脖子，干净利索。
右脚一点，身体避开劈下来的刀锋，犹如蜻蜓点水，每一个动作浑然天成，让人捉摸不透，他的下一个动作，出现在哪里。
仅仅一个照面就损失一人，让剩余四名杀手，脸色骤变，加快了攻击力道。
“你们的刀法太弱了，让你们见识一下，什么才是真正的刀法。”
凌空一个翻转，地面上的长刀落入掌心，身体还在空中，划出一道美丽的弧线，无情的刀锋，撕裂空气。
“嗤！”
毫无征兆，刀气四溅，冲过来的四名杀手还未反应过来，突然定格在原地。
“好快的刀！”
杀手头目脸上的面罩滑落，双眼惊恐，没见过如此可怕之人。
一滴滴鲜血顺着四人的脖子滴落地面，一时半刻还死不了，没有理会四人，一步步朝周桐走过去。
吓得亡魂大冒，一步步后退，身后是高高的墙壁，已经退无可退。

“你……你不是废物吗，怎么会如此强大。”
content_en:
The Xu family has five weapons workshops located throughout Canglan City, producing a large number of weapons every day.
A lot has happened in the past few days. The Xu family's weapon refining master was poached by the Tian family. The newcomer's refining techniques were immature. As a result, the Xu family's weapons always had problems and it took a long time to retrain them.
The weapons brought back from the main hall yesterday were all defective products.
Hurry towards the nearest weapons workshop, the journey takes about one stick of incense.
His ears suddenly twitched, and a sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth: "There are really people who are following me regardless of life and death. I want to see who is following me."
Bypassing the main road, he turned down a street and entered an uninhabited alley. There were tall courtyard walls on both sides, and there was a fishy smell coming from the depths. Many people passing by were taking advantage of this place.
Stopping his body, there was a whooshing sound behind him, and six figures surrounded the exit of the alley.
"Have you been following me for so long, hiding your head and showing your tail?"
Looking at the six people, they were covered in black clothes, leaving only a pair of eyes outside. They were holding bright weapons, and their eyes released a terrifying murderous aura that filled the entire alley.
A man was about to come in to urinate when he encountered this scene. He was so frightened that he ran away without even putting up his pants.
"Trash, today is the day you die. Why don't you kneel down and beg for mercy?"
A deep voice came from the mouth of the man in the middle, approaching step by step, forming a small encirclement to prevent Liu Wuxie from escaping.
The strength of the six people is not low, only one is at the fifth level of the acquired world, and the other five are all at the sixth level of the acquired world.
"Zhou Tong, I didn't kill you in Danbao Pavilion. I didn't expect you to give up. You are digging your own grave."
Liu Wuxie's eyes suddenly focused on the face of a man on the right, and he was so frightened that he took a step back. How could his identity be revealed?
"You trash, you slapped me in Danbao Pavilion, causing me to lose my position in Danbao Pavilion. Today is the day you die."
Zhou Tong took off his mask with a ferocious face. After leaving Danbao Pavilion yesterday, he spent all his savings and hired five killers to guard the front door of Xu's house. Finally he seized the opportunity.
Without the support of Danbao Pavilion, Zhou Tong will be unable to move forward. In the past few years, he has become addicted to gambling and owes a lot of debt. As the small leader of Danbao Pavilion, those creditors dare not do anything to him.
Without the support of Danbao Pavilion, it won't be long before those creditors come to visit one after another, and everything he owns will be completely lost, including the several concubines he raised.
"Even you trash want to kill me."
There was an evil smile on the corner of his mouth. Even if he wanted to kill him even if he was half-stepped to the innate realm, it would be impossible, let alone the small acquired realm.
"Stop talking nonsense to him and kill him quickly!"
The five killers did nothing less than kill, and they didn't say a word of nonsense. The bad guys died because they talked too much. They knew this very well.
The long knife slashed down in the air, and the sword energy hit Liu Wuxie's face, making the air extremely restless. Countless cyclones exploded in the air. A simple combined attack formation corresponded to the directions of the five elements.
Zhou Tong did not take action and stepped aside, with a trace of madness in his eyes.
"A bunch of crumbling dogs!"
Liu Wuxie suddenly disappeared on the spot. He performed the Seven Star Steps and disappeared like afterimages. The attacks of the five people all failed.
Who would have expected that Liu Wuxie would use such exquisite steps, like a ghost, unable to catch any trace, and suddenly appear outside the circle, with his palm like a knife, slicing it off fiercely.
"Crack!"
The man in black in front of him fell on his back, and his neck was cut cleanly by Liu Wuxie's palm.
Pointing his right foot forward, his body avoided the slashing blade, just like a dragonfly touching water. Every movement was natural and unpredictable, as to where his next movement would appear.
One person was lost in just one encounter, causing the remaining four killers to suddenly change their expressions and speed up their attacks.
"Your sword skills are too weak. Let me show you what real sword skills are."
A flip in the air, the long knife on the ground fell into the palm of his hand, while his body was still in the air, drawing a beautiful arc, and the ruthless blade tore the air.
"Tsk!"
Without any warning, the sword energy flew everywhere, and the four killers who rushed over suddenly froze in place before they could react.
"What a fast knife!"
The mask on the killer leader's face slipped off, his eyes were horrified, he had never seen such a terrifying person.
Drops of blood dripped down the necks of the four people and fell to the ground. They were still unable to die for a while, so they ignored the four people and walked towards Zhou Tong step by step.
The soul was so frightened that it retreated step by step. There was a high wall behind it, and it was impossible to retreat.
"You... aren't you a waste? How can you be so powerful?"
